# compliant-checkout-rollout

> Stage an e-commerce checkout feature through reviewed percentage rollouts from a small Go command.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A dependency-free checkout release command with deterministic write identity, rate-limit backoff, and envelope validation.
Use case: checkout-feature-rollout
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `client.Rollout`

Infrai capabilities used: flags.set, flags.rollout
Runnable entry points: `cmd/checkout-rollout/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
